title: DRE-LZSH: SEEG benchmark dataset for drug-resistant epilepsy (ictal and interictal segments, 29 patients)
description: This dataset contains stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 29 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, including ictal (seizure) and interictal segments sampled at 2000 Hz. It is accompanied by clinical information, channel-level epileptogenic-zone annotations, and the authors' high-frequency oscillation and 1/f spectral result tables. The data are re-packaged in iEEG-BIDS from the original Zenodo release as a benchmark for precision-medicine research in epilepsy.
methods_description: Segments of SEEG data were exported from the original release as MATLAB arrays (seizure segments typically 40-60 s, plus longer interictal segments) at 2000 Hz. They were losslessly re-packaged into BrainVision float32 files with BIDS sidecars, with no filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Channel types were inferred from channel names, and no electrode coordinates were available.
